package.name: rv2fr_hw_bringup
package.description: Single-launch entry point for the RV-2FR's MoveIt2 + RViz2 against a choice of hardware backend: melfa_ros2_driver's fake-hardware/real-hardware path, or rv2fr_gz_bringup's Gazebo simulation (use_gz_sim:=true) -- for validating motion planning, collision checking, and reachability without needing RT ToolBox3.
